text: After the breakup I was depressed for most of a year. I kept replaying that night, the things we said, her face changing. I couldn't trust my own judgement about relationships anymore. When I started dating again, I'd sometimes look at the person and feel the same strangeness, and panic. I still wonder whether I destroyed something good.
Ich habe seitdem Angst vor Menschenmengen und gehe nicht mehr auf Festivals oder Konzerte. In vollen Zügen bekomme ich manchmal Panik.

I relapsed after that experience. For six months I was back to restricting and purging. The images of my body swelling came back every time I looked in a mirror. My weight dropped to a dangerous level and I had to go back into treatment. I felt betrayed by the idea that psychedelics could heal everything.

Ich hatte danach Schwierigkeiten, die Bilder meines Freundes, der schreit und um sich schlägt, loszuwerden. Ich hatte Angst, dass meinen Eltern etwas passiert, und habe sie viel öfter angerufen. Wir haben beide keine Drogen mehr genommen.

I've had a sense of cosmic dread for about a year. A feeling that suffering is the deep nature of everything. It comes and goes. I've become more compassionate, though, and I volunteer at a hospice now.

I couldn't look at my parents the same way for a long time. I felt like I was living in a fake family. I had intrusive images of my mother as a young woman trying to end her life, which I'd never seen but imagined vividly. I became withdrawn and angry at home. I didn't tell my parents what my brother had told me for years. My relationship with my brother was strained.

Ich hatte danach lange Zeit Schuldgefühle und konnte bei der Arbeit nicht mehr unbefangen mit sterbenden Patienten umgehen. Ich hatte Albträume, in denen mich die Verstorbenen anklagen. Ich war erschöpft und dachte darüber nach, den Beruf zu wechseln.

I dropped out of the trial. For months I had dreams of endless hospital corridors. I was afraid of any medical procedure involving sedation. My depression, which the trial was supposed to help, got worse for a while.
Nichts Bleibendes. Mit meiner Mutter haben wir später darüber gelacht.

For a long time I felt like I had no foundation. My rational worldview was gone, and I didn't have anything to replace it. I had a constant sense of being watched and judged. I couldn't sleep well and had nightmares of the being. I became obsessed with the question of whether I had really wasted my life, and fell into a depression. I changed jobs, ended a relationship, and moved cities within a year, partly because of the experience. Some of those changes were good, some were rash. I'm still trying to make sense of it all.
I developed OCD checking after that. Doors, stove, windows. It's still there, three years later, though less.

Ich wurde von der Schule verwiesen und musste die Schule wechseln. In der neuen Schule hatte ich keine Freunde und war sehr einsam. Ich hatte Albträume vom Wald und von der Polizei. Meine Eltern haben mir lange nicht vertraut. Ich bin in eine Depression gerutscht, die fast zwei Jahre gedauert hat.
